Executes the ordered cleanup stages for a durable item-deletion job, persisting progress after each stage so interrupted work can safely resume.
The processor reloads the unfinished deletion job while the item lock is held and performs token-scoped cleanup before conditionally finalizing the matching catalog pending-delete state. Progress is persisted after each cleanup stage; if interruption occurs after a side effect but before progress is saved, that cleanup operation may run again on retry.
Cleanup removes only the target item's instance artifacts, sessions, and publication journals. Failures are recorded with bounded exponential retry scheduling and jitter. Cancellation requested through the supplied token is propagated without recording a retry.
